C0282.title: Exploiting Internet of Things Protocols for Malicious Data Exfiltration Activities
C0282.summary: This research presents a method that leverages the MQTT protocol to establish tunneling attacks for data exfiltration. Since MQTT is widely used in IoT environments and commonly permitted through firewalls, attackers can encapsulate and exfiltrate sensitive information.
